entities.summary: Gemma Craven is an Irish actress, now retired. She is best known for her roles as Cinderella in the film The Slipper and the Rose (1976) and as Joan Parker, the frigid wife of Arthur, in the BBC TV drama Pennies From Heaven (1978).
